abstractions.reason: the switch has no simulation model; its supplies, reset, straps and sideband pins are present in the netlist and checked statically, while its lanes and protocol are outside dynamic coverage
REFCLK_100M is driven by a stand-in source; clock availability is an assumption recorded in the fixture contract, so no clock-dependent conclusion may be reported as a pass
the generated buck drives VOUT directly and has no switching node in its reduced behavioural form; the SW pin is left open and this boundary reduces coverage

configuration.note: ILIM_MODE=0 selects hiccup/retry; the clock is an assumption, not a verified path
configuration.notes: Board-level bring-up demonstration: a 12 V input, a generated buck to 3.3 V, a generated LDO to 1.8 V, an open-drain reset supervisor pair driving PERST#, and the synthetic PCIe-switch interface fixture. | The device contract for U5 lives in fixtures/switch_fixture (SYNTHETIC_SWITCH_CONTRACT.md, pins.csv, requirements.json) and every one of those requirements carries origin=TEST_FIXTURE. U5 has no simulation model: it appears in the netlist, in the static checks and in the abstraction list, and it is explicitly outside dynamic coverage. | Nothing here is device data for a real part number.
